title: Lifecycle Management for Legacy Claude Integrations
business: Enterprise software teams maintaining long-running automated document processing pipelines.
problem: Applications relying on retired models like claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 experience service failures because requests to retired models will fail.
solution: Teams must audit API usage via the Claude Console to identify deprecated model calls and migrate workloads to active, supported models such as claude-sonnet-5-5 to maintain service continuity.
steps: Access the Usage page in the Claude Console to export API activity logs.
Filter the CSV export to identify instances where the application is still using retired or deprecated model IDs.
Update the application codebase to reference an active, supported model identifier.
Perform thorough testing of the application with the new model to ensure output consistency before full deployment.
outcome: Restored service reliability and alignment with current model support standards, preventing unexpected downtime from model retirement.
limitation: Migrating to a newer model may introduce variations in output behavior; teams must perform thorough testing of your applications with the new models well before the retirement date to verify performance.
